sign.whyBody: Signatures prove you authorize this action. They happen in your wallet and never move your funds on their own.

approve.name: Token approval
approve.body: Lets Pool Party move your {token} for this transaction. An approval never moves funds by itself. The actual transaction happens in a later step.

permit.name: Permit2 signature
permit.body: A gasless signature that authorizes this transfer. It is a message, not a transaction, so it costs no network fee and nothing moves until you confirm.

confirm.name: Final confirmation
confirm.body: The last step. It runs on the network and actually executes the transaction. This is the only step that may cost a small network fee.

build.name: Preparing transaction
build.body: Pool Party is computing the amounts and the network fee for this transaction. Nothing is signed or sent yet.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Your transaction didn't go through and no funds were moved.

kinds.slippage: The price moved beyond your max slippage before the transaction could confirm. Raise your max slippage in the settings or try again later.
kinds.deadlineExpired: The transaction didn't confirm within its deadline, so it was cancelled. Try again.
kinds.insufficientFunds: Your wallet doesn't have enough to cover this transaction and its network fee.
kinds.userRejected: You declined the request in your wallet. No funds were moved.
kinds.unauthorized: This wallet isn't allowed to perform this operation.
kinds.wrongChain: Your wallet is on a different network. Switch it to {network} and try again.
kinds.wrongChainUnknown: Your wallet is on a different network. Switch networks in your wallet and try again.
kinds.gasBlocked: There is nothing on {network} to cover network costs, so this can't run yet. Buy a little crypto on {network}, or move some over from another network.
kinds.gasBlockedUnknown: There is nothing on this network to cover network costs, so this can't run yet. Buy a little crypto there, or move some over from another network.
kinds.transient: The network or your wallet did not answer in time. Nothing was moved. Please try again in a moment.
kinds.confirmationTimeout: Your transaction was sent, but we could not confirm it in time. Check your wallet's recent activity before trying again, in case it already went through.
kinds.chainUnavailable: Your wallet doesn't have {network} enabled, so it can't sign for this. Enable {network} in your wallet app, then switch to it below.
kinds.chainUnavailableUnknown: Your wallet doesn't have this network enabled, so it can't sign for this. Enable it in your wallet app and try again.
kinds.alreadyBroadcast: This step was already sent and is still being tracked. Reload the page to pick it up. Do not send it again.
kinds.upstreamUnavailable: We could not price a route just now. This is temporary, please try again in a moment.
kinds.rangeUnchanged: This is already the position's range, so there is nothing to move. Pick different bounds to rebalance.

resume.title: You may have a purchase in progress
resume.body: You started a purchase {minutes} minutes ago. If you paid, the money may still be on its way. Resuming waits for it. Starting again creates a new purchase, so only do that if the first one never went through.

slippage.raiseCost: A higher limit lets every remaining conversion, not just this step, go through at a worse price. Raise it only if you want them to complete.
